intent: Implement approved existing-feature UX completion for Windows Rust/egui WordWeave5: clear study input/check/explicit self-grade, start/resume dashboard, actual session result and finish/continue, materials/add vocabulary hierarchy, chat activity/main action, honest records and grouped settings. Shared responsive blue controls, minimum 820x650 and 80–160% text scale. Preserve data/AI/scheduling/media invariants; no image-only expansion. Source version 0.6.0 with unchanged dependencies. Review only; real-device acceptance remains pending.

evidence: src/app/session_end.rs:75 -- if ux::primary(ui, "もう少し学習する", can_continue).clicked() { self.start(self.progress.settings.minutes); }

src/app.rs:445-450 -- let max_new = if minutes <= 2 { self.progress.settings.new_per_day.min(1) } else { self.progress.settings.new_per_day }; let queue = scheduler::make_queue(&self.deck, &self.progress, now(), &today(), max_new);
src/app/dashboard.rs:80 -- let queue = scheduler::make_queue(&self.deck, &self.progress, now(), &today(), self.progress.settings.new_per_day);

Post-review regression evidence: validation/ux-0.6.0-continuation-red.log records cargo test --locked --bin wordweave5 short_default_course_disables_empty_continuation_and_keeps_the_result failing at src/app/ux_flow_tests.rs:215: after continuation on a 1-minute course, result answers became 0 instead of remaining 1. Runtime source stayed at the reviewed working tree; the test was added after full.diff. The test's [1, 2] loop stopped at the first failing iteration.
findings.suggested_fix: Share start()'s minute-dependent max_new calculation with continuation eligibility and study-start candidate preview. With minutes=2, new_per_day=3, one first answer today and no due reviews, continuation currently stays enabled but immediately replaces the previous summary with an empty NoTasks result. Add a regression asserting continuation is disabled and the summary preserved; retain existing scheduler semantics.
findings.title: Use the actual course allowance for continuation eligibility
findings.why_it_matters: With the configured course set to 1 or 2 minutes, new_per_day above 1, one first answer already recorded today, and no due reviews, the result screen enables continuation even though start() cannot create a question. Clicking it replaces the useful prior result with an empty NoTasks result and leaves the same enabled button. The result-screen and start-screen preview queries use the full daily setting; start() applies min(new_per_day, 1), from which make_queue subtracts today's first answers.
findings.validation_reason: With a configured 1–2-minute course, new_per_day greater than 1, one first answer today, remaining eligible new material and no due reviews, newly added src/app/session_end.rs:72–75 enables continuation using the full daily allowance while src/app.rs:442–495 clears the summary and starts an empty queue because src/scheduler.rs:169 subtracts that answer from the short-course allowance of 1; the inspected UI regression at src/app/ux_flow_tests.rs:200–216 and validation/ux-0.6.0-continuation-red.log establish reachability at 1 minute by showing the result count fall from 1 to 0 after the button click, with 2 minutes following the same inspected branch.
